span.p:
No build works with plain Wine.
Install Proton 10+ with Steam or UMU.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Do you use a Steam Deck?

span.p:
Can you install UMU,
and do you want to?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Do you want MangoHud or
other Linux features?

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Do you want fine control over
the installation and runtime?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Both builds work.
The Linux build is easier when UMU works.
